reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for a long time, and I’m very happy to know that my pet is cared for with so much love, professionalism, and responsibility. That is very important to me. Thank you for providing such incredible care and attention to both the pets and their owners.

I continue to have amazing service for my shiba with Sam. She comes back happy and clean and I feel calm knowing Im leaving my dog with someone who not only does an amazing  job but with passion and great service. Cant recommend this place enough.
Excellent service!

Great personalized service, care and attention, obviously loves animals!
The best!

My dog Arthur was just groomed by Sam and I’m very pleased.  Arthur is quite difficult and the last groomer he went to will no longer take him due to his nipping and scratching.  Sam was able to handle him without a muzzle and restraints tools and I noticed he was relaxed and not stressed when I picked him up. Sam also did a great job on his face which is usually very uneven due to trimming with a muzzle on him. I’m sad that we are only visiting Montreal but if I come back I will definitely use them again. Thanks again Sam and Madison Fluff.

We brought our dog Sparky, who is 3 years old, in for his first grooming session. We were a little stressed about how he would react to his first time, but everything went smoothly. I highly recommend this place! Very professional.

He takes such great care of my 10-year-old dog! He always does a fantastic job; my dog ​​always looks wonderful when he comes out, and he's especially careful with his sensitive skin. You can tell he takes the time to make sure he's well looked after. I highly recommend him for all your grooming needs; your dogs will be in very good hands!
Excellent service and a warm welcome. My dog ​​loved it! 😊
Had a great experience. Will be going back.
Great experience with our corgi.  Super friendly and easy.
Sam is very friendly and has a wonderful manner with our Charlie, who is usually uncomfortable with strangers. Sam always does a great job with the grooming! Here’s our Charlie!

Excellent groomer, the dog was taken care of, came well groomed and happy.
It is reassuring to leave a dog with Samuel, who is passionate about the dogs and also very patient and kind.

Super welcoming, enthusiastic, and attentive. You can tell he really loves dogs and knows them well. I told him my dog ​​doesn't like having his nails trimmed, and he was very comfortable with that. I asked him to round off the cut, and he did exactly that, and most importantly, he didn't shave him completely. He took perfect care of my Samoyed, and I could see that he didn't leave there traumatized, unlike in other places.
We had such a lovely experience! We felt that our dog Jolene was in very good hands and she came out looking happy and adorable. Thank you, we'll be back for sure!

I brought Rio here for the first time, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. I was unfortunately running late, and Maison Fluff was incredibly patient and understanding. Rio was so well cared for, and he came home looking adorable. Wonderful service from genuinely kind people! I highly recommend them!
It was my dog ​​Max's first time and it was a very positive experience! Thank you

Sam is so great with my Dante. He gave Sam many kisses, wagging his tail. Dogs know good people, Sam is good people. This will be Dante’s fur grooming  place to go   Also it’s on St Paul St so I can go have lunch at one of the many restaurants in the area while Dante is pampered
Sam is just the kindest guy.  Syd, our anxious Portuguese Waterdog, looooves him.
Attentive, responsive, and efficient service! My little dog came home spotless, with a soft coat and a light fragrance. I highly recommend them!

Sam, the owner of Cage-Free Dog Grooming – Maison Fluff in Old Montréal, is outstanding. Our Maltese absolutely loves him, which says everything.

He’s warm, attentive, and communicates beautifully, making every visit seamless. The grooming products he’s developing already look impressive—I’m looking forward to their release.

Thank you, Sam, for your kindness, hospitality, and consistently excellent care. Highly recommended.
My dog ​​is very anxious, but she loved her experience. Thank you!
My Cockapoo loved his experience! Thank you so much for the professionalism, efficiency, and love my little Natty received! I highly recommend Sam for your furry friends!

We've had excellent experiences with Sam! Our 7-year-old Labrador comes back clean, with a soft, shiny coat that smells wonderful. You can see he's very well washed and cared for.

Most importantly for us, he comes back happy, relaxed, and confident, without any signs of discomfort or stress. It's clear he's treated with gentleness and professionalism.

We recommend this groomer without hesitation!

Hands down the best groomer in the city! I’m always so impressed by attention and care. Every time we leave, the result is absolutely stunning—my dog looks perfect! I wouldn't trust anyone else with my pup. Highly recommend!
Leolo has never looked so handsome. Thank you, Sam, for your impeccable service, warm approach, and professionalism. ❤️🐾 …
wonderful grooming experience! We loved the warm approach,kindness and the attention given to brushing and deshedding. Our dog looks great and seems much happier. thank you for the excellent care !
Superb work, lovely attention to our dog, thank you
Such a great experience for my dog! He came out relaxed, looking wonderful and it was easy to book and communicate. Definitely recommend!

Ever since my dog was groomed on Friday, he has been acting very unlike himself. His skin is extremely red and irritated, particularly around his private area, to a level I have never seen before. I’ve had him groomed short in the past, including times when he had more severe matting, and I’ve never experienced anything like this.

Since coming home, he has been visibly uncomfortable. The grooming itself is also uneven, but my main concern is his condition and behavior afterward. He has barely eaten or drank, does not want to go for walks, has no interest in playing, and overall seems distressed and unwell.

I’m very disappointed and concerned by this experience, and unfortunately I will not be returning.

It was Ginger’s first grooming and I’m honestly so happy with the experience. 🐶✨

She came home super relaxed, calm and went straight to sleep after, which says a lot. You can really tell he genuinely loves dogs and cares about making them feel safe and comfortable.

He was also very professional, gentle, and surprisingly fast. Ginger looks amazing and had such a positive first grooming experience. Highly recommend! 🤍

Thank you, Maison Fluff!
Frida, the royal poodle, has returned calm and playful with her beautiful summer haircut!
My two dogs get groomed by Sam! The haircuts are amazing. He listens to my needs and is very attentive to the dogs. I highly recommend him.
Great grooming experience for my 13 year old dog. He came back looking great and more importantly super happy and relaxed. Will be returning! :)

It is good to entrust your anxious american cocker spaniel for the first time to a new groomer, have a good feeling from the onset and find your dog perfectly relaxed and his long coat well looked after when you return to pick him up a quick lunch later. A million warm thank you Sam 🤗! Fjordi and I will be returning customers. …

The best dog groomer! I can’t overstate how great Sam is. He only takes one dog at a time, so there isn’t constant barking from other dogs that only adds stress to an already stressful activity. You can tell that he really cares about dogs, which gives me peace of mind to know that my anxious senior dog is in good hands.
Amazing dog grooming place! My baby loves it.

Sam is fully bilingual in French and English. On our first visit today, he warmly welcomed us, my dog and I, and asked about what were the needs and HER needs. He was so good with her, at first glance. My dog is usually scared of men, but she felt comfortable with Sam right away.
The results are just as I wanted. She is ready for summertime!
Will definitely book again.
Sam has been grooming my dog since he was a pup. He always does an amazing job and Sonny is always happy to see him!
Always a pleasure! Very professional and caring!
Sam was perfect from start to finish, I'm so happy with the result! My little dog is absolutely perfect! I'll be back :)

I have a golden retriever. He is a bit nervous and is usually not a big fan of grooming. He was instantly happy with Sam. We’ve been going for almost 2 years now and he always looks amazing after his appointment.

It was my little dog's very first grooming appointment, and I was a bit nervous, but as soon as I arrived, I felt completely at ease. Sam is clearly a true dog lover; it shows in his gentleness and attention to detail. My dog ​​was treated with great care and affection. I am extremely satisfied with the service from start to finish, and I highly recommend him!
Excellent groomer! Sam from Maison Fluff is fantastic and my dog ​​loves him. Always impeccable results.

Molly is 4 months old and this was her first experience at the groomer’s! Sam did a wonderful job in making her comfortable and she looked cute as a button when I picked her up. Thank you so much for making Molly’s first haircut moment a memorable one! :)

I'm always so happy to take Abu to Maison Fluff. Sam is incredibly gentle, professional, and very caring with animals. Abu is always warmly welcomed and leaves clean, well-groomed, and visibly happy. You can really tell that Sam loves dogs and takes the time to do things right. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer.
Targa is very happy with her grooming.

We brought our newly adopted 7 year old cocker spaniel Bella to Maison Fluff for some much needed pampering.  Sam knew exactly what grooming would be best for her breed and made her look like a new dog. It only took one interaction with Sam for it to be clear that he loves what he does and genuinely cares about his doggie clients.  Bella looks forward to coming back to see you soon.  Thanks Sam!

My husband brought our Samoyed puppy in for a bath, and I am genuinely blown away by the results. Anyone with a Sammy knows how difficult that double coat can be to manage, but they handled it like absolute pros. Our pup came out looking incredibly fluffy, smelling amazing, and, most importantly, happy and relaxed.
The best part? They are located right in the neighborhood, literally two minutes away from us! Having a world-class groomer so close to home is a total game-changer. It’s clear the team here truly loves animals and takes pride in their work. If you’re looking for the best bath for your fur baby, look no further!
High quality grooming service for our Samoyed puppy!
Sam was fantastic with my shy, anxious Maltipoo! His love for what he does really shines through. Couldn’t be happier—highly recommend!
Sam is so kind! I trust him 100% with my highly sensitive dog. He's attentive and meticulous! I love him! Very well organized! Thank you so much!

My dog ​​is very anxious and usually has a lot of difficulty during grooming. From the moment we arrived, I felt a great deal of gentleness and patience.

The groomer took the time to reassure my dog ​​and me, telling me to take it slow and respect his pace. You can really feel their love for animals and their professionalism. The result is superb: my dog ​​was clean, well-groomed, and above all, much calmer than usual.

I highly recommend this groomer, especially for anxious dogs.
Sam was super friendly and sweet with my dog! Thank you Sam for a great complete grooming!
Very happy with our first grooming here! Winnie looks great and we appreciated receiving a call during the grooming to ask about our preference for the cut. Thank you
Excellent service!! We are more than satisfied, perfect cut and the groomer/owner was very kind and attentive. We will definitely return :)
Our little Morty is always very happy and clean after his appointments with Sam. We've always had great experiences. Best grooming in town, in our opinion! ✨🫧 …
The welcome was fantastic and Sam is incredibly kind. I found my dog ​​clean and happy (not traumatized at all). Sam truly has a way with animals.
Excellent dog grooming service

I take my dog once a month to her grooming to maison fluff and Sam does a very attentive job for her fur since she’s pomeranian and has a double coat which is so sensitive and needs expert care.you can fully trust for a very good care for your furry companions.
5 star experience!! Thank you 🥰 🐕 …

I brought my Parson Russell Terrier, Leia, and I'm extremely satisfied with the service. She came out spotless, well-groomed, and visibly relaxed. You can tell Sam takes the time to care for the dogs gently and professionally. The result is impeccable, and the whole experience was welcoming and friendly. I highly recommend them!
Peanut has been going there for a while now and we both Love it l! She’s this Happy upon arrival♥️🤗. Thank you …

In 11 years of having our amazing dog, this is by far the best groomer we've ever had. They always treat our Sonia with such care, and the results are always amazing. Our dog came home happy, relaxed, and looking fantastic! Truly the best experience.
Very happy with Sam & Maison Fluff! We will be back with Nala 💛 …
Sam was so amazing with my little Mocha! His cut was literally perfect and Mocha was so happy/playful after his groom :)

I am not one for posting reviews but I want to thank Sam for doing such a wonderful grooming on Kee Kee. She looks precious and has received many compliments throughout the day. Going to a new place is often stressful for a dog but she took to Sam and she came out happy and excited!!  I would definitely recommend Maison Fluff  for grooming in Montreal.
amazing service and Paddy was very happy

Our new rescue Monty was so happy at his first spa day at Maison Fluff! He was so well taken care of and his fur was so bright and clean. We are so happy with the results and will absolutely be returning and recommending the services!
Best dog grooming in Montreal! My dog loves Maison Fluff. Super professional and always perfect!

We're so lucky ro have found Maison Fluff while visiting Montreal! Sam was so sweet with our dog, Whistle, and he did a fantastic job with her haircut! We travel a lot and it's always hard to find a good groomer when we're in a new city.  Sam was able to take Whistle on short notice and make her look cute again! Thanks, Sam!

Our Maltipoo Leo, Who is 1.8 years old, has been going to Sam and he absolutely adores him. Sam does such a great job with his grooming even though Leo is very prone to not he make sure he takes his time and he’s very gentle with Leo.

I was a bit reluctant at first not seeing the space the groomer works in.
But his presence was really reassuring and the dog came out beautiful and unharmed (the nails can be easily hurt if one is not carefull). Most important the dog came happy and relaxed.So I sincerely recommend.
Amazing service and grooming. Must recommend.
Excellent service and Sam really knew how to handle my little Pomeranian who is usually very stressed!

Sam was absolutely amazing with Kruz! My golden retriever was long overdue for a haircut and he walked out of there looking gorgeous! You could tell right away that Sam was amazing with dogs and such an animal lover. I felt super confident leaving Kruz with him and Kruz walked out of there so happy! The next time Kruz has some grinch paws, we know exactly where to go!!

I recently discovered Maison Fluff and couldn’t be happier with their grooming services! It’s such a joy to finally find a groomer where my dog, Tod, isn’t pulling away in fear. Instead, he gets so excited that he pulls toward the building :D
When we arrive, Tod is filled with excitement, and after his grooming, he always looks wonderful.
Sam is incredibly friendly and truly knows how to make pets feel at ease. If you’re looking for a groomer that your furry friend will adore, I wholeheartedly recommend Maison Fluff!
It was the first time taking my dog to the groomer, she can be energetic and anxious but Sam took great care of her. I'm very happy with the result, the cut is super clean! I recommend 100%.
A wonderful experience. Sam is very attentive and put our lovely Stella, who is quite shy, at ease. The haircut is very well done and exactly what we asked for.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!!

Very disappointing experience with Sam and Maison Fluff. I paid $80 for a grooming service that was poorly done and incomplete (no nail trimming, which is always included in a full grooming service). I tried contacting the company several times to resolve the situation, but received no response or solution. Very unprofessional and a complete lack of customer service. I absolutely do not recommend them!
It was my first visit to Maison Fluff. The welcome was warm and the service was excellent! Ulysses came back from his grooming appointment so happy! I'll definitely be back! 🐕‍🦺🐾 …

Great experience. My 5 year old chihuahua had never been to a groomers so I was very worried especially because she has sensitive area on her tummy due to a medical condition. She was scared and confused when I left her but the groomer took his time at front of me to get her to allow him to approach, touch and hold her. When I picked her up, she was calm, happy and unbothered. I feel very comfortable leaving my baby there. The wash and nail trim was as I asked and to my satisfaction.
Sam was so kind and gentle with Blue who is my 15 year old cocker. Blue left full of energy and looking like a puppy and the goodest boy! Sam is our new go to groomer whenever we’ll be in Montreal!
My puppy had his first grooming done today and it was great!! They took good care of our little pup and he looks great with his new style🐶 Def will be back for next grooming session …
Sam is amazing! You notice the great energy and care :)) My pup looked so cute!! Coming back for sure~
Great, my dog always look super cute after going there🥰 …

Sam did an amazing job with our doggy. He was the first ever groomers appointment for our 5-month old pup and he did amazing. He sent us photos and updates throughout the session and we felt reassured that our pup was well taken care of. We loved the fact at the end he was kissing Sam as we were worried he was anxious or hated the experience. We had a bit of trouble finding the place at first, but know if you enter the building and go to Room 301 you’ll find Sam waiting for you!
Amazing service! Sam is super caring
Amazing job performed by Sam. Would definitely recommend and come back.

Took our 2 schnauzer puppies for their first haircut here. Very professional. Nice salon. Fantastic haircuts. The owner is super comfortable with dogs and they seem to trust him and like him. Job well done.

My dog has been to various other groomers and does not like getting groomed, but I was very happy to hear that he was very calm during his session with Sam. Sam did an excellent job and gave him a haircut exactly as I requested. He was extremely gentle with my little one, you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. I recommend him to anyone in Montreal!

I arrived in Montreal from Chicago a few days ago and I was able to bring my Shiba Inu to Maison Fluff! Sam did a wonderful job with my dog, Domo, and made sure that Domo was as comfortable as possible when they first met! I had asked Sam …

Extremely kind and did an amazing job on my dog! I often had a problem where other groomers would not listen to what I wanted for his cut, but Maison Fluff did and killed it! Will definitely be going back :)
